newsitem.title: USA: Binks-Sames Corp posts Q4 loss after charge.
newsitem.headline: Binks-Sames Corp posts Q4 loss after charge.

text.p: Binks-Sames Corp said Monday a restructuring charge caused a loss of $12.7 million, or $4.13 a share, in the fourth-quarter ended November 30.
The company said the loss compared to net income of $1.0 million, or $0.32 a share, in the same period a year ago.
Binks-Sames had previously announced it would take a $12.6-million charge to pay for a streamlining of its product line and a reduction of its manufacturing base.
Sales in the latest period reached $98.8 million, up from $74.8 million one year ago.
Binks-Sames makes spray finishing and coating equipment.
Its shares were unchanged Monday at 40.
